messages.content: Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let H be the orthocenter, M the midpoint of BC, E the foot from B to AC, and F the foot from C to AB. Let T=EF∩BC. Prove HT is perpendicular to AM. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let Γ be its circumcircle and K the intersection of the tangents to Γ at B and C. Let U be the center of the circle through B tangent at A to line AC, and V the center of the circle through C tangent at A to line AB. Prove UV is perpendicular to AK. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let E be the foot from B to AC, F the foot from C to AB, and N the midpoint of BC. A circle through A,E is tangent at A to line AF, and a circle through A,F is tangent at A to line AE. Let X be their intersection other than A. Prove A,N,X are collinear. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute scalene triangle ABC, let M,N,P be the midpoints of BC,CA,AB, respectively. The perpendicular bisectors of AB and AC meet ray AM at D and E, respectively. Let F=BD∩CE lie inside triangle ABC. Prove A,N,F,P are concyclic. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC with AB≠AC, let H be the orthocenter, M the midpoint of BC, and P the foot from H to line AM. Prove B,C,H,P are concyclic. Write the entire proof in English.

Prove the following statement. Explain the assumptions and decisive steps. You may use standard theorems, but derive any nontrivial configuration-specific fact rather than citing a name alone. In an acute triangle ABC, one circle passes through A,B and is tangent at A to line AC; another passes through A,C and is tangent at A to line AB. Let T be their intersection other than A, and suppose T lies inside triangle ABC. Prove AT²=BT·CT. Write the entire proof in English.
